_comment: Tier-2: the KratosChimeraApplication wheel ships the pybind module but omits libKratosChimeraApplicationCore.so, so the import fails after a SUCCESSFUL pip install. Pitfall (kratos.chimera #3). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). MEASURED CORRECTION TO THE VERSION CLAIM: the pitfall pins this to the 10.4.2 wheel; the defect is UNFIXED at 10.4.3. KratosChimeraApplication==10.4.3 installs cleanly and then import KratosMultiphysics.ChimeraApplication raises ImportError 'libKratosChimeraApplicationCore.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory'. This is a different failure from a missing wheel — the module IS present on disk, which is why 'pip install succeeded' is not evidence the application works. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. INDEX RENUMBERED 3 -> 1: guidance entries were moved out of kratos.chimera's pitfalls list, which shifted the indices of the entries after them. The claim this fixture verifies is unchanged.
